messages:
elaine: Starting quick heads-up 4: staging->prod cutover prep for customers.addresses schema change in 15m. Plan: pin gateway-api to v5.0.0 during window, add column address_verified, staggered backfill. Quiet slot 00:30-02:00 UTC.

omar: ACK. Table size and expected lock behavior?

elaine: ~2.2M rows in prod. ADD COLUMN is instant. Backfill will run ordered updates in small batches to avoid long locks. Expect transient row locks only.

tess: Backfill config suggestion: BATCH_ROWS=2000, SLEEP_MS=300, MAX_CONCURRENCY=6. Add safepoint validation every 20k rows.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled by @elaine: migration-job v2026-06-20 queued. Canary running on 2 workers with sample=5k rows.

nick: Canary pass criteria? any auto-pause thresholds?

elaine: Criteria: 0 constraint errors, median batch latency <200ms, peak lock_wait <50ms. Auto-pause if 3 consecutive batch errors or lock_wait median >60ms for 2m.

sre-oncall: I'll watch lock_monitor, replication lag, and long transactions. If lock_waits exceed threshold for 2m we hit holdpoint and pause. I'll post to #incidents.

deploy-bot: canary results: 5k rows processed, 0 violations, avg batch 140ms, peak_lock_wait 18ms. Canary SUCCESS.

omar: Good. Please include snapshot info in release note and location of validation logs.

elaine: added release note: "snapshot: rds-prod-snap-2026-06-20-0030; revert: rds-restore --from rds-prod-snap-2026-06-20-0030; logs: s3://redwood-migration-logs/1769700000/"

tess: Rolling to 30% workers now. Will post updates at each step. :thumbsup:
